objective: Learn informative representations capturing relationships between medical images and their associated textual descriptions.
operational_goal: Paired image-to-text and text-to-image retrieval; exact paired row is the target. Retrieval is a measurable proxy, not the entirety of representational quality or clinical validity.
genuine_labels: No label column in prepared data; captions are paired descriptions, not class labels.
dataset: ROCOv2; 8000 training pairs, 1000 validation pairs, 1000 held-out test pairs.
selection: Mean of image-to-text and text-to-image validation Recall@5, same validation split for all candidates; test only after selection.
limitations: Other relevant images or captions may be treated as negatives or incorrect retrievals; pretrained image and text feature extraction remain fixed.
